doc_sources.note: ROBOTS-BLOCKED FOR OUR FETCHER. Denis's ruling 2026-08-20: reachable by a human, or by an independent Playwright session run deliberately outside the pipeline -- never by the automated fetcher. Authored as kind:"portal" precisely because DISCOVER only ever prefills a manual task from a portal source and never enqueues fetch.url for it. media.amanngirrbach.com/robots.txt is `User-agent: * / Disallow: /` -- the entire DAM, every path. NOT FETCHED. Found 2026-08-20 in the live footer of both amanngirrbach.com/ and /de-de/; a previous pass failed because the site was rebuilt on WordPress with /{lang}-{country}/ paths, every old Downloads URL died and archive.amanngirrbach.com was retired, so search results still rank URLs the origin no longer serves. Their own printed IFUs direct users to Services > Downloads > Ergaenzende Unterlagen for the Konformitaetserklaerung, so declarations are published behind this disallow. The main brand domain is freely crawlable (only /wp-admin/ disallowed) but its sitemap.xml lists 38 blog/training URLs and omits every product page -- unfinished migration, useless for discovery.
